newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev closes flat ahead of IMF mission.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev closes flat ahead of IMF mission.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev ended at 240-241 per dollar, virtually unchanged from 239.50-241 in the morning after a very thin interbank forex trade ahead of an International Monetary Fund (IMF) mission, dealers said.
"The lev idled near 240 in low volumes throughout the day as market players have adopted a wait-and-see approach," a commercial bank dealer said.
The central bank was reported to have offered dollars near 241 levs for most of the day, capping the downside for the lev and locking trade in a narrow range, traders said. @
But generally there was not much willingness to trade ahead of an IMF mission expected to arrive on Thursday to evaluate the Socialist government's reform performance, dealers said.
"Market makers are reluctant to take risks before the mission comes up with a conclusion," another dealer said.
The mission is expected to review Bulgaria's progress in strengthening financial discipline and agree on reform policies that could unblock a twice-delayed second $115 million tranche of funding.

According to traders the lev could ease on Thursday due to the longer value date of that day's spot deals but a sharp fall was unlikely if foreign currency remains low, said traders. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
